kolkata-2005.notes: Source 1 is the IIT Kanpur CSE department site (2001-2004 Kanpur-site ACM pages); no page of this edition. Source 3 lists 24 Honorable Mention teams of the preliminary online contest as well.

sources.evidence: The crawl is the IIT Kanpur CSE department site; its ACM ICPC pages cover the 2001, 2002, 2003 and 2004 Kanpur-site contests, and none of the pages I read is about the 2005 Kolkata contest.
Page headed 'The 2005 ACM Asia Programming Contest - Kolkata sponsored by IBM' with a Final Round table dated 10/29/2005.
Page 'Results of Kolkata Site Contest' on the IIT Kanpur ACM site with a 24-row ranked table of Rank, Institute Name, Team Name, Solved, Time, whose top teams match the other standings page.

kolkata-2015.notes: Source 6: CodeChef page in our copy is an empty modern shell; the archive also holds an older Wayback capture of the same address that I did not read as it is not the copy of this source. Site crawl mixes the 2015 section with 2016-2018 pages of the same host.

sources.evidence: The /2015/ pages of icpckolkata.in announce the Kolkata Site Contest of 25-26 December 2015 hosted by NITTTR Kolkata and link its result, problem set and director's report PDFs, which are in the copy.
Table of 60 rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation under the title 'The 2015 ACM-ICPC Asia Kolkata Regional Contest'.
Two-page PDF headed 'Result of Onsite Contest' listing ranks 1 to 9 and then Honorable Mention teams, with no solved counts.
One-page PDF headed 'Result of Preliminary Online Contest' numbering 60 teams by team name and institute, with a note to the selected teams.
27-page PDF titled 'The 2015 ACM ASIA Region Programming Contest Kolkata Site, Onsite Contest Problems' with eleven statements coded KOL1501 to KOL1511.
The copy is a generic CodeChef 'Contest Page' shell with company address, roadmaps and compiler links, and no contest name or problems.
